title: Plenora plan budget fragment v1
description: Validates only the fragment governed by plenora-plan-budget-v1: the plan format version and the two budget members of limits. Members this contract does not govern are permitted, because a conforming plan carries many more. The comparison between the two budgets is NOT expressible here — JSON Schema cannot compare sibling values — and is enforced as a semantic check instead.

allOf.$comment: PLAN-007: the field exists only in plan format version 6.

positive_u64.$comment: PLAN-008: positive integer representable in an unsigned 64-bit integer.
